title: Add Aizen to video_audio
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Aizen](https://aizensuske718-ctrl.github.io/Aizen) to video_audio
- App Description: A static web application featuring an Arabic (RTL) interface that implements the Pollinations.ai BYOP OAuth 2.1 PKCE login flow entirely on the client side, without a backend server. 

Fixes #15819

gist.headline: Aizen joins the garden
gist.blurb: Aizen is now listed in video_audio. Its Arabic, right-to-left interface handles Pollinations login in the browser—no backend required.
gist.summary: Added Aizen to the video_audio app listing, featuring an Arabic RTL interface and a client-side Pollinations.ai BYOP OAuth 2.1 PKCE login flow.
gist.impact: Visitors can discover an Arabic RTL app that completes BYOP login entirely in the browser, without a backend server.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Aizen as a friendly browser window with a right-to-left Arabic interface, rather than inventing a mascot or logo. Polli, wearing tiny reading glasses, helps guide a pixel key through a browser-only login path; flowers and code-plants surround the screen.
